description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Language, which manages localization, message retrieval, and formatting for the HTML Purifier library. It handles language codes, error messages, and localized item listing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Language
classes.description: Manages localization messages, error names, and message formatting for HTML Purifier.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the language object with configuration and context.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Lazy loads language data from the factory cache.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a localized message by key.

methods.name: getErrorName
methods.description: Retrieves a localized error name by error number.

methods.name: listify
methods.description: Converts an array into a localized, readable string.

methods.name: formatMessage
methods.description: Formats a localized message with dynamic parameters, including handling tokens and arrays.
